name: charly-qwen3-tts
description: Self-contained skills for the Qwen3-TTS speech-service family: the OpenAI-compatible speech API (POST /v1/audio/speech, GET /v1/audio/voices) that Open WebUI's `openai` TTS engine calls, served over the upstream qwen-tts python API by a charly-owned shim.
